title: A Toast to the Ghost Haunted Pub Crawl in Downtown Orlando
includes: Parting gift for each paid admission
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the spooky side of Downtown Orlando on this haunted pub crawl. Join a Ghost Ambassador to uncover chilling tales as you visit lively bars and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere. This social adventure allows you to mingle with fellow ghost enthusiasts while using K2 meters to sense the spirit world. Enjoy drink specials and grab quick appetizers at select stops while keeping the night moving. This ghostly experience lasts 2–3 hours, making it a perfect outing for those aged 21 and over looking for a unique night out.

- Engage in storytelling and socializing at haunted bars
- Use K2 meters for a touch of ghostly interaction
- Enjoy drink specials and quick appetizers at select stops
- Perfect for groups of 6 or more with private tour options available
- Pictures of your outing are included FREE of charge
